$comment: #EDE-65 lane I: THE agent chat document both hosts draw (docs/chat.json: eDE's chat in the ground, the IDE's agent and chat pages later), a pure projection of ONE conversation the host already resolved, replayed in TS (src/chat.ts) and Rust (uicore-model chat.rs). The host builds the rows from the domain's chat rows (session-chat.json; the words other fixtures own, a divider's label, an event's text, a card's state word, come resolved), so this layer owns only how the chat is drawn. FACE: no sessionId = `home` (the Agent page: the agent row over the composer, composer-home.json: placeholder `copy.homePlaceholder`, the label `copy.to` with the picked agent's name, rows always empty); a sessionId = `conversation` (header = the title + the agent's icon, the rows, the composer with `copy.placeholder` while the host's composer has the `/` menu (`slashCommands`: the IDE), else `copy.messagePlaceholder` (chats.json copy.emptyPlaceholder) with the title as {name}: eDE never promises a menu it does not have). AGENT ROW: single select over `agents` in the given order; `agentId` picks one, an unknown or null pick falls back to the first; no agents = no label and nothing selected. ROWS keep their order; every row carries EVERY field (a template binds any of them), the ones its kind does not use blank: `` strings, false, [] or null. A message by `user` = kind `user` (`bubble` = the chat's `bubbles`, session-chat.json chatModeCases; caption: bubbles = the time alone, inside the bubble; a transcript = `name · time` under it, a missing part dropped with its separator; `queued` kept); by `agent` = kind `agent` (bubbles = a left bubble with its time; a transcript = plain prose, no caption); any other author (a system note) = THE `marker` (#EXP-1772, below), its body as `text`. `pill` (a /new or /compact divider, a locked row) = kind `pill`, its label as `text`. `line` (a subagent) and `card` (a session card, a report, a plan row, a surface or suggestions card; `target` = the session a press opens) pass through. CARD SURFACE (lane Q): a `card` or `question` may carry `surface` = the genUI card the document draws in an Embed under its title (`{root, data, version?}`: an `exponential_show` surface, a plan's or question's inline surface; the host passes a closed card's answered data model as `data`); it passes through as is, absent = null, and every other kind's is null. `question` = kind `question` with `copy.questionIcon` (waiting-cards.json icons.question), the question as `title`, its options (each carrying the row's id as `messageId`: a template cannot read its parent), custom, multi, waiting and answer. `picture` = its attachment and the caption as `text` (blank without one). #EXP-1772 MARKER (transcript-grouping.json: only real messages are bubbles): `marker` (an event line, a system input) = kind `marker`, its label as `text`: THE inline marker, a centred muted label between two hairlines, full width, never a bubble. GROUPING (#EDE-65 lane O, the IDE's transcript, transcript-grouping.json): a message may carry `group` {side, avatar, indent, link, gap} the host resolved; every row carries side, author, relay, time, avatar, indent, link and gap. In bubbles, a user or agent message's `side` = group.side when `in` or `out`, else `out` for `user` and `in` for `agent`; `author` = its name on an `in` bubble (blank on `out`); #EXP-1772 RELAY: a message whose group `link` is set (another session's message, the session id the name opens) is a relay: `author` blank, `relay` = its trimmed name + ` ` + `copy.linkChevron` on an `in` bubble with a name (blank otherwise), the line the document draws ABOVE the bubble, outside it, the ONLY press (`ede_chat open {sessionId: link}`): the bubble itself never opens anything; every other row's `relay` is blank; `time` = its time trimmed; in a transcript they are blank. avatar (blank when absent), indent and link pass through on every user or agent message, blank everywhere else. GAP = the space above a row in px: a user or agent message with a group = its gap (absent = 0), a host row 0 (it paints its own), every other row 16 (the old list gap), the first 0. `host` = a row the host paints itself (the document holds its place in an Embed the host claims by its painted id), every field blank. empty = no rows. COMPOSER: canSend = the draft has a non-blank character, nothing is sending, and on home an agent is picked; busy = a turn is running (submit becomes stop).
